title: A place the agency does not serve: the bot offers the agency's places, no option invented

turns.customer: I want a car in Sousse tomorrow morning at 9 until Friday 9am.

script.reply: Sorry, we don't serve Sousse. You can pick up the car at our agency in Tunis city centre, at Tunis-Carthage airport or at Enfidha-Hammamet airport. Which one suits you?
